fields.Name: T215 - Developer Tools Lazy Loading Chunk Filter
fields.Description: Exercises the lazy-module chunk registry with its loaded/not-loaded filter (OnFilterClick/FilteredChunks) and progress computation - a distinct data source and filter unique to this inspector.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and choose the Admin app. Open the 'Developer Tools' section, then in its left sub-navigation click 'Lazy Loading'. Observe the load-progress bar (percent of chunks loaded) and the summary stats. Click the 'Loaded' filter pill and confirm the chunk grid narrows to loaded chunks, then click 'Not loaded' and confirm it shows the remaining chunks (or a valid empty state if all are loaded), then click 'All' to restore the full grid. Success is the filter pills FILTERING the chunk cards. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Lazy Loading inspector renders a progress bar and a grid of code-split chunk cards with loaded/not-loaded status
Clicking the Loaded / Not loaded / All filter pills changes which chunk cards are shown (or shows a valid empty state), confirming the filter responds
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
